{{Quote|At Muunilinst, a three-way fleet battle rages among forces loyal to Head of State Fel and Moffs Woolbam and Callron the Younger.|A newscaster, during the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]]|<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>}}
'''Callron''', also known as '''Callron the Younger''', was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] who was a member of the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="Apocalypse" /> Callron the Younger was likely a relative to [[Garret Callron]], the Moff of the [[Clacis sector/Legends|Clacis sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> In [[44 ABY]], during the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]], he sided with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] and the Moff rebels against Imperial [[Head of State (Imperial Remnant)|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]].<ref name="Ascension" /> Simultaneously, he and the other Moffs came into smaller conflicts, including a [[Battle of Muunilinst (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|battle at Muunilinst]], that eventually led to the [[Imperial Election of 44 ABY|Imperial election]] of [[Vitor Reige]] as Head of State.<ref name="Apocalypse" />
